integrity: The proof begins from the published graphical-zonotope vertex model, rewrites centered squared vertex norm as a constant degree term minus the number of directed two-edge paths, classifies those paths by multipartite triple type, and proves that noninterleaving block orientations are exactly the maximizers. The cubic-moment formula is then an exact symmetric-polynomial simplification; finite enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to complete multipartite graphs and the standard unweighted graphical-zonotope realization. It does not solve the corresponding acyclic-orientation norm maximization for arbitrary graphs or weighted generators. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent result under orientation-imbalance or oriented-matroid terminology.
title: Complete multipartite graphical zonotopes have cubic-moment circumspheres
